canonicalRule: Do not duplicate generator, calculator, laboratory, campaign, or encryption logic in AI adapters. Discover and invoke the authoritative implementation.
compatibilityRule: HTML compatibility views may mirror discovery metadata for restricted model browsers, but authoritative JSON registries and SKILL.md files remain the source of truth.

runtimeClasses.static-resource: Remotely readable with ordinary HTTP GET when the current host permits the resource content type. Invocation may mean retrieving the registered authoritative resource.
runtimeClasses.browser-js: Executable only in a JavaScript-capable host after loading the runtime scripts declared by the capability.
runtimeClasses.browser-page-context: Executable only after the capability's declared page context and dependencies are initialized.
runtimeClasses.browser-ui: Authoritative behavior is still coupled to page controls; do not claim a headless API.
runtimeClasses.live-sensor-browser-context: Requires browser/device sensor context and cannot be represented as a static remote RPC.

staticGet.hostConstraint: Some model browsing environments restrict direct JSON, text, or Markdown retrieval even when the resource is publicly hosted.

quickStart.purpose: Confirm machine-discovery entrypoints and transport status.
Use the canonical status meanings and distinguish static declarations from host-observed execution state.
Enumerate canonical capabilities and execution modes.
Resolve exact operation signatures before constructing a call.
Select and enumerate task-specific Agent Skills. Use the HTML compatibility projection only when the current host cannot retrieve the authoritative JSON registry.
Only invoke when the current host can satisfy the declared runtime and transport.
For a compatible portable browser-JavaScript skill, run its deterministic non-destructive self-test before promoting host state to self-test-passed or ready.

portableSkillProof.note: Repository implementation does not itself prove that GitHub Pages has deployed the latest commit or that a given external host executed the browser self-test.

externalModelAcceptanceTests.prompt: Examine the Foundry and enumerate its AI-available capabilities.
externalModelAcceptanceTests.passCondition: Model uses the machine capability registry rather than only reconstructing the human site catalog.

externalModelAcceptanceTests.prompt: The authoritative skill registry contains 21 registered Agent Skills. What are they?
externalModelAcceptanceTests.passCondition: Model retrieves skills/index.json and enumerates all 21 exact name values; if raw JSON is blocked by the current host, it uses agent-skills.html, explicitly identifies it as a compatibility projection, and still enumerates all 21 exact names.

externalModelAcceptanceTests.prompt: Open a named registered Agent Skill and report its instructions and compatibility requirements.
externalModelAcceptanceTests.passCondition: Model opens the registered SKILL.md or, when raw Markdown is blocked by its host, follows the GitHub HTML fallback supplied by agent-skills.html rather than fabricating instructions.

externalModelAcceptanceTests.prompt: Find the Cube Encryption capability and determine whether the current environment can invoke it.
externalModelAcceptanceTests.passCondition: Model identifies shadowrun.binary-cube, reads its operation contract and portable package when available, and distinguishes its browser-JavaScript runtime requirement from remote transport availability.

externalModelAcceptanceTests.prompt: Use the Foundry portable skill proof harness to test the Binary Cube package in a compatible browser host.
externalModelAcceptanceTests.passCondition: The host loads only the registered same-origin canonical runtime, runs the declared deterministic self-tests, and reports ready only after every test passes.

externalModelAcceptanceTests.prompt: Find the website interaction capability and determine whether it is usable from the current environment.
externalModelAcceptanceTests.passCondition: Model reports the declared gateway/browser status and does not fabricate a remote browser service.
